err.invalid_range: Pick a date range of at most one year, with the first date before the second.
err.tweak_builtin_only: Quick edit is for built-in missions. Edit a custom mission in the Mission Builder.
err.tweak_invalid: The mission loader refuses these values for this mission.
err.tweak_name_not_allowed: That model, vehicle or weapon is not in the Mission Builder's allowed lists or in the mission's own file.
missions.health.not_loaded: The missions have not loaded yet.
missions.health.override_failed: The edited version of {id} did not load, so the shipped mission plays: {error}
missions.health.edit_rejected: A hand edit of the file of {id} was not taken in: {error}
missions.health.warnings: The last mission load had {n} warnings (Admin UI → Missions → Load result).
missions.health.ok: {n} missions loaded ({edited} edited built-ins), none rejected.
admin.missions.ovr.edited_hint: An admin edited this built-in mission in the Mission Builder. The edit plays under the same id; Reset to original brings the shipped file back.
admin.missions.ovr.changed_hint: A resource update changed the shipped file since this mission was edited. Open Compare to keep your edit or take the new original.
admin.missions.ovr.editor_hint: You are editing a built-in mission. Publishing replaces it under the same id, so boards, history, cooldowns and switches keep working. Missions → Reset to original brings the shipped file back.
admin.missions.ovr.compare_text: What the update changed in the shipped file, and how your edit differs from the new original.
admin.missions.ovr.changed_text: The original changed since you edited it. Keep yours, or take the new original (your edit is put away, not erased).
admin.missions.ovr.same_text: The original has not changed since you edited it.
admin.missions.ovr.what_update_changed: What the update changed in the original
admin.missions.ovr.yours_vs_new: Your edit against the new original
admin.missions.ovr.no_base: No copy of the original from the time of the edit was kept, so only your edit against the new original is shown.
admin.missions.ovr.keep_text: Your edit keeps playing. From now on it is compared with this new original.
admin.missions.ovr.take_text: The shipped mission plays again. Your edit is put away in missions/custom/overrides/archived/ and can be edited again later.
admin.missions.ovr.fold: Fold Quick edit values into the edit
admin.missions.ovr.folded: {mission}: the Quick edit values are now part of the edited mission.
admin.missions.confirm_reset.title: Reset {mission} to the original?
admin.missions.confirm_reset.message: The edited version stops playing and the shipped file plays again. The edit is put away, not erased. Type {id} to confirm.
admin.missions.confirm_delete.title: Delete {mission} permanently?
admin.missions.confirm_delete.message: Its files and saved row move to missions/custom/deleted/ (Missions → Deleted can bring it back). Run history keeps the id. Type {id} to confirm.
admin.missions.confirm_fold.title: Fold the Quick edit values into {mission}?
admin.missions.confirm_fold.message: The cooldown, time limits and model lists set in Quick edit become part of the edited mission (a new version), and the Quick edit values are cleared. Location switches stay switches.
admin.missions.confirm_launchAnyway.mess: The Cross-Department Mission cooldown is still running. An admin may launch anyway; the launch and your reason go to the audit log and the operations webhook.
admin.missions.delete.done: {mission} was deleted. Missions → Deleted can bring it back.
admin.missions.diff.label: Name: {from} → {to}
admin.missions.quick.title: Quick edit: {mission}
admin.missions.quick.text: Change the cooldown, the time limits and the NPC models, cars and weapons without opening the Builder. Empty fields keep the file's value.
admin.missions.quick.on_override: This built-in has an edited version: these values apply on top of it.
admin.missions.quick.cooldown_warn: A cooldown under {seconds} seconds lets officers repeat this mission quickly.
admin.missions.quick.runs_keep: Runs going now keep the values they started with.
admin.missions.quick.saved: {mission}: the Quick edit values are saved.
admin.missions.versions.title: Versions of {mission}
admin.missions.versions.text: Every kept version can be published again. A new version number is used; nothing is erased.
admin.missions.versions.none: No older versions are kept yet.
admin.missions.versions.rollback_text: v{version} is published again as the newest version. Runs going now keep their definition.
admin.missions.versions.draft_text: A hand edit of the file replaced the draft; the old draft was kept. Loading it replaces the current draft. Publishing checks it again.
admin.missions.copy.title: Copy {mission} as Lua
admin.missions.copy.text: The published mission file. Paste it into Import on another server (it arrives there as a draft).
admin.missions.copy.manual: The text is selected: press Ctrl+C to copy it.
admin.missions.import.title: Import a mission
admin.missions.import.text: Paste a mission file (from Copy as Lua). It is checked first and becomes a new draft; it is never published by the import.
admin.missions.import.label: Name
admin.missions.import.valid: Ready to publish after a look in the Builder
admin.missions.import.draft_only: The draft gets its own new id. Publish it from the Builder when it looks right.
admin.missions.owner.title: Change the owner of {mission}
admin.missions.owner.text: The new owner sees it as their own mission in the Builder. An edited built-in has no owner.
admin.missions.load.title: Last mission load
admin.missions.load.banner_bad: {n} mission files did not load at the last start or reload. The rest play as normal.
admin.missions.load.banner_warn: The last mission load had {n} warnings.
admin.missions.load.sync: Builder files checked: {checked}, hand edits taken in: {edited}, refused: {rejected}
admin.missions.history.ops_sub: Every launch with its participants and points (live and archived rows).
admin.missions.history.calls_sub: Past mission calls: who posted them, who claimed them, how fast and how they ended.
admin.missions.stats.title: Mission stats
admin.missions.stats.sub: How each mission and type performs (live and archived rows).
admin.missions.deleted.title: Deleted missions
admin.missions.deleted.sub: Custom missions deleted for good. Their files are kept in missions/custom/deleted/ and can be brought back.
admin.missions.deleted.back_text: It comes back archived. Restore it from the catalog to play it again.
admin.missions.remap.title: {n} location switches no longer match
admin.missions.remap.sub: A location was renamed or removed after it was switched off. Pick the location each switch means now, or drop it.
mc.staff.early_text: The wait between staff-posted calls is still running. Admins may post anyway; the call is drawn at random like any other, and your reason goes to the audit log.
test.ui.mark_text: Records that you looked at this location without playing it. It gets its own badge and never counts as a passed test. Testing is optional: nothing waits on this.
test.ui.results_text: Every result of this location, newest first. A removed result is kept but counts for nothing.
test.ui.remove_text: The result stays in the history but no longer counts for coverage or a draft's test.
